title: Copilot: choose whether copied answers keep citations
summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot is adding a 'Copy with sources' option that lets users decide whether citations are included when they copy a Copilot response (MC1568700, 25 November 2026). It is on by default; users can turn it off to copy text without citations. Rollout is from mid- to late December 2026, worldwide. Microsoft says no admin action is required and recommends telling users about the option.
why: Citations are how a reader checks where an AI answer came from. Making 'copy without sources' one click away makes it easier to paste unattributed AI text into documents and mail, which is worth a line in your AI use guidance.
todo: Do now: add a sentence to your AI use guidance that copied Copilot output keeps its sources when it is reused in documents others rely on.
Mention the option in user communications for December.
Wait: there is no admin setting to configure.
effective_note: Mid- to late December 2026 per MC1568700.
